foundations.title: Transformational Intelligence: Learning to Change the Game
foundations.mechanism: Purpose-preserving construction of representations, observations, assumptions, coordination and intermediate objectives; executable realization plus bridge to original purpose.
foundations.result: Declared passive causal model limited to 50% accuracy; intervention policy 8191/8192 in at most 12 queries. Unrestricted optimal planner ties.
foundations.limits: Exact synthetic causal-identification example; not LLM discovery performance or universally superior algorithm.
foundations.lesson: A new photon instrument must change feasible acquisition/acceptance while retaining the original scientific quantity and constraints.

foundations.title: Invent the Economy
foundations.mechanism: Joint technical capability and voluntarily accepted arrangement; outside options, participant benefit, cash timing and complete costs.
foundations.result: Four hypothetical buyers; shared core plus commitment produces $120,000 expected contribution at assumed 80% qualification. Success gives $300,000 contribution but requires $900,000 prefunding. $40,000 per-delivery route overhead reverses expected gain. Independent ledger checks 2,240 parameter cases.
foundations.limits: Supplied exact model, fictional buyers/costs; no live demand or token-price evidence.
foundations.lesson: Compare pooled/OEM-license/one-off arrangements using competent conventional delivery, with restricted deposits and financing separate from profit.

foundations.title: Transformational Autonomous Enterprises
foundations.mechanism: Mission-relative revalidation of source-bound reusable generic module checks; fresh mission inputs/outputs always checked. Weighted BOM demand changes to Boolean dependency-remediation algebra.
foundations.result: 48 missions, 40 valid/8 invalid; reuse/full replay/direct specialist all correct. 64 vs 1,600 generic checks (96% reduction), 88.85% reference-step reduction including fresh checks. Direct expert matches quality with lower candidate events/CPU and better final median wall time.
foundations.limits: Supplied algorithms and synthetic tasks, known-bank confirmation after lineage repair; no complete monetary bill or industrial qualification.
foundations.lesson: Reuse should reduce justified repeated qualification, but same-artifact ordinary-library and expert controls are mandatory.

foundations.title: Out-Learn: Change What You Need to Know
foundations.mechanism: Construct sampling times, polarity and correction weights under gain uncertainty and polynomial drift; calibrate-use contract.
foundations.result: Least-cost synthetic one-use quadratic-drift pair costs 13 resource units, error 3/1003. Different calibration becomes optimal beyond 19 uses; scope-changing successor preserves valid gain evidence and replaces measurement program.
foundations.limits: Exact synthetic measurement architecture; no physical primitives or established business.
foundations.lesson: Calibration/observation contract matters for photon timing; inherited timestamp calibration must not silently certify a changed device.

foundations.title: Out-Think: Transformational Intelligence for Inventing the Space of Reasoning
foundations.mechanism: Executable representations preserve required answers and permitted operations; old representation may need retirement.
foundations.result: At p=101, replacement uses 303 states (9 bits), while executable refinement preserving old code requires 10,201 (14 bits). Checks cover 1,099 small conflict graphs, 80 orbit models, 40 general systems and 46,584 contextual cases.
foundations.limits: Finite supplied reasoning contracts; classical foundations; no neural/frontier gain.
foundations.lesson: Temporal-event state must preserve future update semantics, not only present output; source/range guards should be explicit.

foundations.title: Out-Design: Creating the Freedom to Transform
foundations.mechanism: Purpose-preserving executable replacement releases capacity in a location that makes future transformation reachable.
foundations.result: Joint Boolean program 171 to 111 abstract instructions under 120 limit; 11 services preserved on 11 slots with one slot freed. Correct vacancy enables 8 endpoints; reversed vacancy enables none of 7 changed endpoints. Successor supports 12 services.
foundations.limits: Finite abstract program/occupancy model; not physical instruction counts or autonomous industrial invention.
foundations.lesson: A software reduction counts only if it releases the actual scarce acquisition/FPGA/customer resource.

foundations.title: Out-Strategise: Constructing the Conditions of Success
foundations.mechanism: Joint observation selection and construction of a common completion across remaining uncertainty; purpose-specific quotient.
foundations.result: 16-world example costs 7 vs 11 optimal observe-repair and 20 no-observation construction. 1,024-world example 7 vs 67/160. Quotient 65,535 beliefs to 69; agrees on 75,967 beliefs. Stronger successor invalidates old route.
foundations.limits: Authored exact networks and abstract costs, not model speedup or AlphaEvolve superiority.
foundations.lesson: Do not require discovering every hidden fact if a construction can deliver robustly; a stricter successor needs fresh acceptance.

foundations.title: Out-Execute: Constructing the Conditions of Completion
foundations.mechanism: Executable boundary value contracts allow changed subproblem answers without re-solving unaffected parts; select/rebuild/check/compose.
foundations.result: 576 synthetic snapshots match full enumeration; 158 updates leave external contract unchanged. Saved 98-task capability extends to 101 tasks by one new module and 32 retained modules; stronger fixed-certificate executor competitive.
foundations.limits: Finite separable systems, not new generic variable-elimination theory or industrial deployment.
foundations.lesson: Temporal kernel and verifiers can be retained only when boundary assumptions remain valid; trace/instance checks stay fresh.

foundations.title: Out-Evolve: Building the Means of Discovery and Production
foundations.mechanism: Construct a useful system for which a simpler model is true; first productive capability builds means for a different successor.
foundations.result: Conditional response law: arbitrary 20-bit function needs 1,048,576 exact scalar queries, qualified quadratic class 211; compatible 21st control needs 21 additional calibrations. Retained shear program 10 actions opaque vs 8 transparent; fresh search also 8. Shared metrology construction costs 17 vs legacy 20, but qualified equal-cost rival leaves zero demonstrated margin.
foundations.limits: Conditional declared function classes and supplied grammars. Proposed fluid-manifold machining→assembly/calibration→thermal-fluid station is not physically built. Bias control destroys measurement gain. Failed combined operator/coalition experiment retained.
foundations.lesson: Photon instrument compiler is an instrument for next acquisition capability; physical timing/interface guarantees cannot be inferred from finite digital trace agreement.
